name: @vidverge/track-b
description: VidVerge Track B — Product Video module (HyperFrames). 8-stage file-based pipeline: intake → plan → assets → build → validate → render → qa → deliver. Orchestrator-agnostic, no MCP, offline-capable rendering once assets are frozen.
$comment: No runtime npm dependencies by design: Node built-ins + the hyperframes CLI via npx + direct HTTPS to model APIs. Keys expected in the environment: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (plan/build/qa), and GEMINI_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY (asset generation).
